scope: All eleven user-approved families are integrated after native art review. Twenty-three species replace twenty-three weaker overlapping species;220 active species and100 families remain. Original authoring and all replaced renders are preserved.
root_corrections: Driftile has eight plates plus one gap in a 3×3 arrangement.

options.theme: Moose and underwater gardening. Real aquatic foraging becomes fictional living rake and root anatomy.
visible_evolution: Tiny forked brow buds and splayed seedling hooves.
Broad rake antlers, a deeper swimming chest and channelled brow.
Huge palmated antler channels comb submerged vegetation; long rootlike hooves brace the marsh floor.

options.theme: Porcupine and locking climbing anchors; quills form the creature’s own bracing frame rather than loose projectiles.
visible_evolution: Short blunt quills and a thick rounded tail.
Alternating hooked quill bars interlock as the broad tail braces against the back, producing a compact climbing-anchor silhouette.

options.theme: Black bear and a living dream den. Its own folding body shelters an original luminous dream-face.
visible_evolution: A cub curls behind small crescent forepaws.
Large folding forearms protect a newly developed chest recess.
An enormous dark bear folds crescent arms around its hollow chest, enclosing a small luminous dream-face.

options.theme: Freshwater turtle and living sundial. Shell scutes create a second shadow expression above its sheltered real face.
visible_evolution: A low shell bears one raised asymmetric ridge.
An asymmetric fan of raised scutes casts shifting facial shadows; the narrow real face stays beneath the front overhang.

options.theme: Woodpecker and cavity architecture, with chisel and climbing-brace shapes grown as anatomy.
visible_evolution: Short wedge beak and a compact supporting tail.
A deep notched chisel beak, braced feet and three developing tail blades.
A strong forked chisel beak and three stiff tail blades support the climber; folded wings create two large nestlike openings in its silhouette.

options.theme: Marten and false branches. The body itself bends into a crooked branch silhouette.
visible_evolution: A flexible youngster has a sharply bent back and small divided tail.
An angular jointed back and broad forked tail align with branch shadows; a narrow pale throat slit reveals the hidden face.

options.theme: Mudpuppy and protective nursery. Permanent external gills become fictional sheltering fans.
visible_evolution: Three pairs of small external gills frame a broad head and flat tail.
Broad interlocking gill fans shelter recovering creatures beneath the head; the flat tail folds forward into a living cradle.

options.theme: White-tailed deer and discarded antlers returning as protective limbs; an original fantasy rather than a borrowed sacred being.
visible_evolution: Soft velvet brow shoots and a small folded white tail.
An empty crown marks the head while two shed antlers hover beside it as curved protective limbs; the white tail opens into a stark warning fan.

options.theme: Sundew and finger trap. Sticky leaf margins interlock around a false inviting face.
visible_evolution: A small sticky rosette conceals tiny eyes beneath its central leaf.
Six broad curling leaf arms interlock gland-tipped margins around an inviting apparent face; the real eyes remain sheltered beneath the central leaf.

options.theme: Whirligig beetle and opposing lookout stations at the waterline.
options.visible_evolution: Solo silhouette: four large eyes ring one horizontal waterline seam; upper and lower paddle pairs turn independently around a compact spinning body.

options.theme: Duckweed colony and sliding puzzle, expressed as one rearranging living body.
options.visible_evolution: Solo silhouette: eight large floating leaf plates plus one empty square form a 3×3 sliding puzzle. Its single real eye peers through the gap; dangling roots rearrange into feet as the plates slide.
